purpose: One-time final held-out evaluation of Model 1 (tender duration). Frozen before any test target is read.

test_set.definition: original Stage 2A test split: valid labels with first tender published 2023-07-01..2024-10-20 (>= 730 days follow-up before the 2026-10-20 snapshot)

target: duration_days = contract_signing_date - first tender notice publication date; modelled as ln(duration_days); point prediction exp(yhat)

refit.eligibility: train + validation rows (first tender 2019-07-01..2023-06-30) whose contract was signed on/before 2023-06-30 (strictly as-of)

features.preprocessing: ml/stage2b/regression.py make_pipeline: OneHot(min_frequency=20, infrequent handling), median imputation, log1p, StandardScaler; fitted inside training folds only

candidates.B1: median by method x category, fallback method -> category -> global, k = 1 (Stage 2A); long score = cell exceedance share
candidates.Ridge: PRIMARY. alpha from logspace(-3, 3, 25) by 5-fold GroupKFold(project), CV metric MAE days
candidates.RandomForest: CHALLENGER. n_estimators 500; grid max_depth {4,6,10,None} x min_samples_leaf {5,10,20} x max_features {0.3,0.6,1.0}; same CV

long_duration.score_regression: P(D > 365) = 1 - Phi((ln 365 - yhat) / sigma), sigma = SD of out-of-fold training log residuals
long_duration.alert_rule: threshold maximising F1 on training out-of-fold scores subject to alert rate <= 30%; ties -> higher threshold

prediction_interval: P10-P90 from out-of-fold training log-residual quantiles
cv: GroupKFold(n_splits=5) by project_id on refit rows

metrics.uncertainty: paired cluster bootstrap, 2,000 resamples, project clusters and package clusters, seed 20261025

selection_rule: Recommend Random Forest only if its MAE reduction vs Ridge is positive with both project- and package-cluster CIs excluding zero and it is not worse on unseen projects or long-tender F1; otherwise prefer the simpler stable model (Ridge if it is not worse than B1, else B1). No post-test experiments.
disclosures: Phase 1 diagnostics printed the median of the test window (141.5 days) and the Phase 1 EDA showed medians for fiscal years overlapping the test window; the test is therefore not completely blind.
Validation was reused across Stage 2A-2D comparisons; Ridge and Random Forest were chosen with knowledge of validation results.
Population: linked, observed, signed contracts from advertised tenders in the 184 reference-linked cohort projects; not all published tenders and not the World Bank portfolio.
